subject: english
question:
**Find the part of the sentence containing an error:**

That none of the delegates considered the plan workable (1)/ is less surprising than the fact (2)/ that neither the director nor the adviser (3)/ were notified earlier. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The error in the sentence lies in part **4**, where the verb "**were**" is incorrectly used.
 
• The subject "**neither the director nor the adviser**" is singular because "neither...nor" construction agrees with the nearer subject, which is singular ("adviser").
 
• Hence, the verb should be singular: "**was**" instead of "were."
 
• Thus, the error is in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"That none of the delegates considered the plan workable is less surprising than the fact that neither the director nor the adviser **was** notified earlier."*
